page.notes: Italic "hac" in the first italic line of verse 27 is read as printed; it may be "hæc". The word "Christianorum" is split across the line end ("Chrifti" / "anorum"); a hyphen may be present but is not clearly visible, so it is written whole. The final word "etiam" is partly cut off by the right edge of the scan. Ligature "ct" in "sancto" and "sanctis" has been expanded to normal spelling. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
